functions.name: buildCalendar
functions.signature: buildCalendar(data: readonly ContributionDay[], opts?: CalendarOptions): Calendar
functions.description: Lays out days as a weeks × 7 grid with levels, totals and month labels. Dates are handled in UTC.

functions.name: computeStats
functions.description: Total, active days, best day, longest streak and current streak. A current streak isn't broken by a quiet today.

functions.name: cropCalendar
functions.signature: cropCalendar(cal: Calendar, n: number, locale?: string | undefined): Calendar
functions.description: Keeps the last `n` weeks. Levels come from the full calendar, so cropping doesn't change colors.

functions.name: fetchGitHubContributions
functions.description: Fetches the last year of contributions from GitHub's GraphQL API. Server only (Node 18+, Deno, Bun, edge runtimes). A classic token with `read:user` includes private contributions.

functions.name: fetchGitLabContributions
functions.description: Fetches a GitLab user's calendar. The endpoint is public but sends no CORS headers, so call it from the server or at build time. Pass `baseUrl` for self-hosted instances.

functions.name: formatDate
functions.signature: formatDate(iso: string, locale?: string | undefined, opts?: DateTimeFormatOptions): string
functions.description: Formats an ISO date with `Intl`, in UTC so the day never shifts.

functions.name: fromDates
functions.description: Counts occurrences per day: blog posts, workouts, local commits… Strings are sliced to the date; `Date` objects use the local date.

functions.name: fromGitHub
functions.description: Converts a GitHub GraphQL response into `{ date, count }` days.

functions.name: fromGitLab
functions.description: Converts GitLab's `{ "2026-03-01": 4 }` calendar into `{ date, count }` days.

functions.name: generateSampleData
functions.signature: generateSampleData({ seed, profile, days, endDate, }?: { seed?: number | undefined; profile?: SampleProfile | undefined; days?: number | undefined; endDate?: Date | undefined; }): ContributionDay[]
functions.description: Deterministic sample data: the same seed always gives the same days. Useful for demos and tests.

functions.name: makeLevelFn
functions.signature: makeLevelFn(counts: readonly number[], scale?: LevelScale): (n: number) => Level
functions.description: Returns a function that maps a count to a level from 0 to 4 for the given counts and scale.

functions.name: mergeSources
functions.description: Adds several sources day by day (for example GitHub plus GitLab), sorted by date.

functions.name: resolveTheme
functions.description: Returns the theme object for a preset name or a custom theme; unknown names fall back to `github`.

functions.name: themeVars
functions.description: Turns a theme into CSS variables (`--cg-l0-light`, `--cg-l0-dark`…); the stylesheet picks light or dark.

constants.name: GITHUB_CONTRIBUTIONS_QUERY
constants.description: GitHub GraphQL query for the contribution calendar. It needs a token even for public data, so run it on the server and never send the token to the browser.

constants.name: sampleProfiles
constants.description: Available sample profiles with a short English label.
